messages:
alex_m: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we need to bind owners to the remaining remediation items and set realistic timelines. I sketched a small RACI for top 3 actions.
sana: thanks. can you paste the items?
alex_m: Sure — short list: 1) KV cache eviction thresholds (perf regression) -> JIRA-7123, 2) model fallback policy gap -> JIRA-7124, 3) nightly compaction job flaky on Dedicated -> JIRA-7125.
jamie: re: JIRA-7123, I can own the investigation + fix. R:jamie A:eng-platform C:ops SRE I:product
marta: I can be A on the fallback policy (JIRA-7124) but need an eng-ml owner for behavior tests. @sana ?
sana: I can sign up as eng-ml owner for 7124. I'll write the acceptance tests. A:Marta R:Sana C:kevin I:product
kevin: for 7125 nightly compaction — we've seen recurrence on 03/11 and 03/17. I propose rotating oncall pair to own the rollout for 2 weeks then handback. R:kevin A:eng-sre C:eng-infra I:customers
jamie: timeline proposals: 7123 - triage by EOD Mon, PR by Thu; 7124 - test matrix by Wed, canary by next Tue; 7125 - tiki run + mitigation by Fri. Agree?
sana: ok for 7124 dates. I need access to the private dataset for the behavior tests — @ops-bot can you open a ticket?
ops-bot: Created internal ticket OPS-2048 to provision dataset for sana. ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:
alex_m: assigning owners in Jira now. I'll add the RACI table to each ticket and link the postmortem.
marta: quick ask — can we add a recurring eval to catch regressions early? Maybe weekly smoke harness for KV patterns.
kevin: yes, add an automated alert on tail-latency and a weekly report to #eng-sre. If we persist alerts for 3 weeks without owner updates, escalate to me.
jamie: noted. I'll add subtask in 7123 for the smoke test and calendar invite for a quick sync on Wednesday 09:30.
sana: small heads-up — the test dataset includes PII; ops-bot ticket should request KMS-scoped access and mask rules.
ops-bot: OPS-2048 updated: KMS-scoped creds + mask pipeline requested.
alex_m: good. final ask — can owners post a brief daily tick in the jira comments until closure? That will help the next postmortem.
kevin: will do for 7125.
marta: I'll post daily updates for 7124 until canary complete.
jamie: 7123 updates will be on PR + jira comments.
sana: starting tests tomorrow morning, will update 7124 by EOD Wed.
alex_m: thanks all — I'll close this loop by adding a follow-up umbrella ticket linking 7123/7124/7125 and set a 30-day review. If any owner needs to push timelines, mention here or update the ticket. :thumbsup:
